One furnished bedroom available in East Village. We're 2 working professionals in our 20s and 30s looking to fill one of our spots for at least 3 months, potentially longer. Aiming for an early April move-in date, but we can be flexible.

The room and apartment come furnished and include heat, air conditioning, and elevator access. A dresser and dedicated closet space will be provided for clothing storage. We have a laundry room in the building. Our community has 24-hour security.

We’re both pretty career oriented but also like to enjoy all that New York has to offer. If we’re not working, we’re usually working out, going out with friends in the city, or going to concerts.
